action.command:
cd /tmp
echo "=== admin login POST ==="; curl -sk --resolve admin.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 -c /tmp/admin.txt https://admin.localhost/admin/login/ -o /dev/null
CSRF=$(grep csrftoken /tmp/admin.txt | awk '{print $7}')
curl -sk --resolve admin.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 -b /tmp/admin.txt -c /tmp/admin.txt -e https://admin.localhost/admin/login/ \
  -d "username=admin&password=AdminLocalPassw0rd!&csrfmiddlewaretoken=$CSRF&next=/admin/" \
  -o /dev/null -w "login POST:%{http_code} redirect:%{redirect_url}\n" https://admin.localhost/admin/login/
echo "=== admin index after login ==="; curl -sk --resolve admin.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 -b /tmp/admin.txt -o /dev/null -w "admin index:%{http_code}\n" https://admin.localhost/admin/
